t: ff.15 A taste of the metaverse
st: More food for thought on the reality to come, from Off-White to Louis Vuitton

sec.p: Selling Pulp Fiction's direction: at the last NFT conference in New York (NFT.NYC), Tarantino announced he would put up for sale a digital copy of the (handwritten) screenplay of Pulp Fiction. The distribution studio he works with, Miramax, didn't take it too well.

sec.t: ff.15.2 Not just bags and shoes
sec.p: Always a pioneer in dialogue with the digital world (remember the collaboration with League of Legends?), Louis Vuitton launched a mobile game for its 200th anniversary. Playing as a Zelda decked out in flowers and LV, you have to collect as many candles, for the brand's…

The pandemic forced us into digital events (like Billie Eilish's session). But I find it more fascinating to use an already virtual world (like Fortnite) as the setting for an event that, until a few years ago, would only have happened in real life.
As you'll have figured out by now, I like throwing numbers around. Quantifying trends.
Virgil Abloh, the recently departed graphic designer and founder of Off-White, worked a lot on the intersection between the real and the digital.
If the metaverse is going to be this important, meta-physical 3D renderings will be the order of the day. For immersive and completely "new" realities.
